body.accepted_partial_input_rule: A source need only supply a material operand, guard, evidence constraint or contrary premise consumed by the receiving analysis. Proving the whole receiving predicate is unnecessary. Being useful somewhere in the same lifecycle is insufficient.
body.actual_basis: The two adverse witnesses expose reuse of semantic-junction negatives after a qualified source has an actual required native input/constraint at another endpoint. The original comparison was semantic. Its scope stopped too early when a standalone central conclusion, shared concern membership or unchanged full predicate was treated as enough to dismiss a consequential operation/input/domain/qualification component. For ESA009 and ESA010, inspect the source-produced interaction or typed-dependence fact at its real observation scope and the complete native receiving operation that actually consumes it. Retain independent norms, costs, actors, formal models and empirical populations. Actual component use is material without establishing the whole predicate. No topic label, potential workflow co-location, unchanged formal result or missing full benefit proves absence.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: A consequential architectural, maintenance or family-boundary decision is actually being made; a taxonomy alone activates nothing.
cluster_rules.distinctness: Architectural significance is not maintenance-purpose classification, and neither supplies a warranted family boundary.
cluster_rules.name: Consequential scope and legitimate product intent
cluster_rules.shared_concern: Determine the object and obligations to which a proposed decision actually applies.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Use concrete affected concerns, intended effects, artefacts and consumers rather than a discipline or category label.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: Evidence or artefacts cross a representation, build or action boundary; irrelevant input changes need not trigger revalidation.
cluster_rules.distinctness: A description identity, a source baseline, a derivation recipe and a delivered product remain different objects.
cluster_rules.name: Identity across descriptions, interventions and derivations
cluster_rules.shared_concern: Prevent a claim about one baseline or representation from being consumed for a different realised subject.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Relate the relevant architectural mapping, exact maintenance candidate and configuration/asset/tool inputs.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: The particular interface, translation or formalism is used by the product; REST and Wright are never mandatory.
cluster_rules.distinctness: Architecture interaction, supported-observer compatibility, schema meaning and feature contracts have different bearers and theorem assumptions.
cluster_rules.name: Semantic obligations across interfaces
cluster_rules.shared_concern: The meaning and interaction assumptions on both sides of a consequential boundary must fit.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Expose state, ordering, data meaning and permitted substitutions; establish only the selected contract or formal claim.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: An actual change or design-change scenario can affect another obligation; proven local independence admits local review.
cluster_rules.distinctness: Static slices, executed traces, co-change, architectural uses and feature mappings are not interchangeable edge types.
cluster_rules.name: Typed cross-boundary impact
cluster_rules.shared_concern: A change can escape a local analysis through dependency kinds or configuration mappings that local evidence omits.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Combine justified dependency kinds, relevant comprehension and feature/build-to-realisation links; challenge consequential missing edges.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: Shared assets or future flexibility are being considered, not merely a single implementation with parameters.
cluster_rules.distinctness: Architectural family constructibility is not a product-line economic case or a maintenance support promise.
cluster_rules.name: Warranted commonality and anticipatory flexibility
cluster_rules.shared_concern: Shared production and hidden variation need credible consumers rather than speculative universality.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Examine commonality, plausible variation and its support burden against independent products or selective reuse.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: A quality or benefit claim supports a consequential choice; small concrete examples may discharge the concern.
cluster_rules.distinctness: Architectural response measures, maintenance-task outcomes and family coverage cannot be added into a universal quality score.
cluster_rules.name: Quality criteria and selected populations
cluster_rules.shared_concern: An acceptable result is relative to real concerns, observers, configurations and hard constraints.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Use explicit response conditions and representative product/maintenance scenarios; keep sacrifices and excluded populations visible.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: A view, solver, generator or transformation is being used as evidence beyond its own object.
cluster_rules.distinctness: Description conformance, SAT, engine tests and product acceptance establish different claims.
cluster_rules.name: Model, tool and actual-product assurance layers
cluster_rules.shared_concern: A valid representation or successful analysis is not automatically a valid realised system.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Keep model adequacy, encoding/engine validity, correspondence and actual-subject evidence separate.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: Loss or disagreement of knowledge can change an actual future decision; unconsumed documentation may be omitted.
cluster_rules.distinctness: Present justification, historical evidence, recovered structure, feature meaning and a maintenance handover are distinct.
cluster_rules.name: Useful rationale and reconstructible knowledge
cluster_rules.shared_concern: Later consumers need useful reasons and checked relationships, not document volume or fabricated historical intent.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Retain a small accessible explanation with its baseline, uncertainty and reopening condition.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: A decision affects another actor, product, baseline or external state; one authorised actor can discharge several functions.
cluster_rules.distinctness: Architecture trade-off authority, maintenance action authority and shared-asset arbitration remain context-supplied, not merged into a new owner.
cluster_rules.name: Authority is not evidence or tooling
cluster_rules.shared_concern: Knowing, proposing, accepting evidence and executing an effect do not automatically convey one another's decision rights.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Retain existing scoped decision rights and negotiated obligations at the consequential handoff.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: Cross-team dependencies, turnover or shared-product demand threaten delivery or support.
cluster_rules.distinctness: Conceptual integrity is not centralised staffing; a knowledge metric and an organisation chart do not prove capacity.
cluster_rules.name: Practical capacity and coordination
cluster_rules.shared_concern: Responsibility must remain actionable with willing capacity and adequate cross-boundary communication.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Match accepted shared work and dependent decisions to actual capability; resolve conflicts without prescribing team topology.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: Investment, continuation or retirement depends on expected value; qualitative comparison is legitimate.
cluster_rules.distinctness: Architecture quality, maintenance effort, variability economics and sustainability boundaries are separate inputs, not additive independent benefits.
cluster_rules.name: Lifecycle alternatives, cost bearers and uncertainty
cluster_rules.shared_concern: A locally attractive decision can shift unacceptable cost or violate a population-specific obligation.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Compare feasible alternatives over the relevant horizon, respect hard constraints, and expose uncertainty and who bears costs.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: A changed model, interface, constraint or implementation is accepted or rejected on compatibility grounds.
cluster_rules.distinctness: A stable name, unchanged feature-set language or historic architecture does not establish behavioural compatibility.
cluster_rules.name: Preservation and deliberate revision
cluster_rules.shared_concern: Preserve legitimate observer obligations while permitting authorised changes; historical equality is not the objective.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Separate observed behaviour, intended differences and surviving promises; test the relevant actual interactions.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: Migration or reconfiguration creates consequential intermediate states; a justified atomic switch can remove them.
cluster_rules.distinctness: Architecture consolidation, maintenance data transfer and configuration migration have different costs and authorities.
cluster_rules.name: Migration, coexistence and reachable states
cluster_rules.shared_concern: Valid endpoints do not discharge the obligations of reachable mixed states or temporary paths.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Inspect transfer seams, conversion semantics, supported version/configuration combinations and remaining repair routes.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: A material observation or assumption change can alter justified action; no fixed feedback cadence follows.
cluster_rules.distinctness: Product-to-core feedback, architectural fitness checks, regression feedback and distribution drift have different signals and consumers.
cluster_rules.name: Observation, feedback and revision
cluster_rules.shared_concern: Changed observations can reopen assumptions rather than merely report a score.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Return a scoped observation to an actor able to change the relevant decision, evidence claim, constraint or support choice.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: An applicable baseline, selection, generator, observer, environment, tool or obligation changes while evidence is reused.
cluster_rules.distinctness: The validity index supplies arguments to inherited invalidation; stronger support in another lineage does not upgrade a local evidence ceiling.
cluster_rules.name: Selective evidence applicability and invalidation
cluster_rules.shared_concern: Evidence is reusable only for the subject, assumptions and claim it actually supports.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Relate architectural mapping and observer assumptions to candidate/build/configuration identity; invalidate dependent claims without discarding unaffected results.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: Refactoring, decomposition, consolidation or variability restructuring is justified by its claimed payoff.
cluster_rules.distinctness: Service count, catalogue compliance and configuration count are distinct proxies; their common limitation does not make the mechanisms equivalent.
cluster_rules.name: Structural intervention versus actual benefit
cluster_rules.shared_concern: A structural label, metric improvement or more reuse does not by itself justify intervention.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Connect the selected structural mechanism to an actual task, quality or product-production consequence and a cheaper alternative.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: An acceptance argument composes local results; whole-product checks can be cheaper than reusable contracts.
cluster_rules.distinctness: Wright connector deadlock freedom, transformation preservation, metamorphic relations and feature contracts use different semantics.
cluster_rules.name: Reusable local proofs and composition premises
cluster_rules.shared_concern: Local results transfer only through discharged semantic and realisation premises.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Check applicability, environment, interface assumptions and actual correspondence before reusing a proof or test result.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: Full applicable checking is costly or a sample is being used to support a wider claim.
cluster_rules.distinctness: Test ordering is not test selection; configuration coverage is not an oracle; mutation and differential evidence remain scoped.
cluster_rules.name: Sampling, regression selection and oracle limits
cluster_rules.shared_concern: A selected scenario or test population must match the stated question and cannot certify every unexamined case.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Select evidence by consequential interactions and budget, validate the oracle/harness, and expose exclusions.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: Independent edits, deltas, releases or runtime actions can interfere semantically.
cluster_rules.distinctness: Textual merge, delta applicability, version skew and feature interaction are different sources of joint-state risk.
cluster_rules.name: Concurrent change and joint interaction
cluster_rules.shared_concern: Changes that are acceptable in isolation can alter each other's assumptions when jointly effective.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Check actual merged, ordered or interacting combinations; allow demonstrably disjoint work concurrently.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: Runtime variation or live adaptation is materially required and its operational envelope can be justified.
cluster_rules.distinctness: Static feature validity, controller nonblocking, architectural compatibility and effect-aware recovery are not the same guarantee.
cluster_rules.name: Runtime change, recovery and action envelopes
cluster_rules.shared_concern: Valid selected states and local improvements do not guarantee safe, authorised or recoverable transitions.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Couple observations, permitted action, state/interface assumptions, actual actuation and the promised residual repair path.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: A shared asset or architecture decision crosses a product or organisational boundary.
cluster_rules.distinctness: The same mechanism may inform several participants, but internal ownership, supplier control and autonomous product acceptance remain distinct.
cluster_rules.name: Shared-asset responsibility and product autonomy
cluster_rules.shared_concern: Shared decisions affect product-specific obligations without automatically creating common decision authority.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Identify affected products, responsible asset participants, practical support and a proportionate arbitration/exception path.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: A decision, conflict, retirement or interaction changes another participant's obligations or required action.
cluster_rules.distinctness: Publishing a notice, issuing a command and achieving the consumer's real-world effect are different postconditions.
cluster_rules.name: Consumer-directed communication
cluster_rules.shared_concern: The affected actor must be able to interpret and act on the relevant consequence.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Communicate changed meanings, support and permitted responses through a channel the real consumer can use.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: A scaffold, feature, service, record or support programme is being stopped or declared complete.
cluster_rules.distinctness: No new products, no new changes, no running service and no retained history are four different boundaries.
cluster_rules.name: Completion, support-aware retirement and historical retention
cluster_rules.shared_concern: Removing new demand does not discharge older supported products, data or recovery obligations.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Check residual consumers and state obligations; retire, reclassify enduring coexistence or retain a supported historical baseline.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: Automation is proposed for a bounded task or extrapolated into a lifecycle capability.
cluster_rules.distinctness: Architectural advice, patch repair, deterministic generation and regenerative replacement are distinct interventions with different evidence.
cluster_rules.name: Bounded automation versus lifecycle replacement
cluster_rules.shared_concern: Task assistance does not establish autonomous architecture, maintenance or superior product-line regeneration.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Keep suggestions as candidates; check exact outputs, intent, tool versions, authority and total work; retain unresolved broader claims.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: Learned components, generation or context-dependent features materially influence supported behaviour.
cluster_rules.distinctness: A fixed feature selection does not imply fixed data or context; neither a model version nor a configuration hash alone determines behaviour.
cluster_rules.name: Learned, generated and environmental dependencies
cluster_rules.shared_concern: Consequential behaviour can change through data, generated inputs and environment even with unchanged conventional source.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Include relevant non-code dependency and observation envelopes in impact and evidence applicability.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: The selected mechanism imposes material resource or coordination burden; unneeded machinery can be omitted.
cluster_rules.distinctness: Energy is not lifecycle sustainability, model memory is not total repair cost, and theoretical variants are not realised value.
cluster_rules.name: Resource constraints and costly flexibility
cluster_rules.shared_concern: Assurance, variation and distribution consume resources that may outweigh the protected benefit.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Compare footprint, operation, support, evaluation and opportunity costs under explicit hard constraints.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: An actual decision is justified by label/category membership rather than the named property's conditions.
cluster_rules.distinctness: These are analogous inferential limits, not one taxonomy or a shared implementation mechanism.
cluster_rules.name: Classification and labels without universal mandates
cluster_rules.shared_concern: A name, category or descriptive regularity does not by itself prescribe an operative method or guarantee.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Retain the specific semantic criterion; do not promote an architectural, maintenance or product-line label into authority.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: A proposed programme is not justified by current or credible future need.
cluster_rules.distinctness: A useful unchanged product need not become a family, and rejecting universal rewrites does not ban a justified replacement.
cluster_rules.name: Legitimate local, unchanged and non-family alternatives
cluster_rules.shared_concern: Deliberate non-change or a smaller production arrangement can be the adequate choice.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Compare feasible intervention and non-intervention branches against the same live obligations.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: A model, schema, feature vocabulary, recovered account or tool representation changes or crosses a boundary.
cluster_rules.distinctness: A rationalised explanation is not historical proof; feature-set equivalence is not data or product-observer equivalence.
cluster_rules.name: Semantic translation and model evolution
cluster_rules.shared_concern: Names and structural mappings can preserve syntax while changing meaning.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Establish the relevant correspondence, loss conditions and external meaning before transporting a claim between models.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: A shared invariant or historical baseline is used to constrain a proposed evolution.
cluster_rules.distinctness: Architectural stability, maintenance preservation and family commonality have different legitimate scopes.
cluster_rules.name: Stability under justified evolution
cluster_rules.shared_concern: Stable shared obligations and adaptable local implementations can coexist only under explicit boundaries.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Preserve required invariants and support while admitting authorised exceptions, revised models and product-local changes.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: Debt or shared-asset investment is proposed as the reason to restructure.
cluster_rules.distinctness: Architectural debt, maintenance debt and variation synchronisation cost can overlap without being independent monetary quantities.
cluster_rules.name: Causal liabilities and prospective payoff
cluster_rules.shared_concern: A predicted future burden needs a specific change/use scenario and an affected cost bearer.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Retain an actionable liability and compare repay/defer/retire branches; observe actual task consequences.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: A proposed form costs more than needed or a cheaper form might omit a consequential distinction.
cluster_rules.distinctness: A local walkthrough, slice, variability model and joint control arrangement are distinct forms and may legitimately be absent.
cluster_rules.name: Proportionate knowledge and control forms
cluster_rules.shared_concern: Required distinctions and protected outcomes, not document/tool/meeting counts, determine adequate form.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Choose the smallest coherent view, explanation, review or analysis; retain escalation on consequential uncertainty.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: Evidence is being transported to a different population or a stronger claim.
cluster_rules.distinctness: These epistemic similarities provide no multiplication of confidence and no new empirical study.
cluster_rules.name: Evidence populations and limits of generalisation
cluster_rules.shared_concern: A setting-bound observation or proxy must not become a universal capability, safety or economic claim.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Preserve population, horizon, measurement boundary and independence limitations alongside every cross-lineage use.

cluster_rules.activation_guard: A significant driver genuinely requires decomposition or construction work; a local direct decision remains legitimate.
cluster_rules.distinctness: Recursive design is not a mandatory sequence between lineages, and product derivation does not confer change authority.
cluster_rules.name: Driver refinement across design and product construction
cluster_rules.shared_concern: Consequential requirements must remain connected to the responsibilities and derivation choices that realise them.
cluster_rules.shared_mechanism: Refine selected design elements, allocate obligations and inspect product/maintenance consequences with feedback to earlier assumptions.

individual_directional_refinements.semantic_basis: Typed architectural relations identify dependency kinds that change-impact propagation must distinguish; the existence and relevance of each edge still need evidence.
Feature-to-realisation mappings expose generator, build and shared implementation paths missing from a code-only change boundary.
Typed actual-change propagation supplies candidate affected products; family support scope decides which need action.
Configuration/asset/tool identity supplies the realised-product scope of an architectural conformance observation.
A model-level architectural claim cannot transfer to a product before the consequential correspondence has been checked.
Family use may not extend a formal architectural result beyond its quantified configurations, assumptions and realisation mapping.
Decision reopening must narrow the dependent operative claim when its evidence assumptions fail; merely marking the decision old is insufficient.
Repaired configuration validity does not retain behavioural-oracle evidence whose relevant assumptions changed.
Changed permissible test configurations provide selection-envelope information; test-selection soundness still uses its own dependency assumptions.
New mixed architecture/data/runtime states need obligation evidence or prevention; endpoint success does not discharge the path.
A permitted new configuration cannot license unsupported intermediate combinations created by migration.
A safe transition must not consume a promised recovery route without feasible replacement or legitimate residual-loss acceptance.
Interface state, ordering and side-effect assumptions identify obligations the dynamic transition must preserve.
Actually feasible state-transfer and activation paths supply transition evidence for architecture-level post-change assurance.
A shared-asset decision that changes a consequential architecture trade-off must retain the affected parties' real decision rights, not create an overriding family owner.
Shared-asset contribution and release rights constrain which maintainer can resolve a cross-product request.
Checked architectural suggestions do not grant permission to alter code, deployment or external state.
Accepted generated migration advice remains within actual delegated object and action authority.
Architecture migration completion must account for residual consumers, data authority and recovery use of temporary paths.
Older supported products can remain consumers of a scaffold even after variability is closed to new products.
Local proportionality must be assessed as part of the actual combined inquiry/validation/coordination burden, without losing live protection.
A separately defensible family governance action does not justify redundant or conflicting combined controls.
Architecture supplies hard quality limits and sacrifices that a lifecycle economic comparison must not average away.
Intervention, validation, disruption and future-support costs supply lifecycle scenario inputs, not a universal return estimate.
Product population, reuse horizon and support scenarios can change the ranking of feasible architectural alternatives.
Information hiding can support a stable architectural substitution boundary when the predicted variation and interface assumptions actually hold.
A supported product exception may use a different implementation without defeating required conceptual integrity; uniformity is not the common criterion.
Wright connector deadlock freedom under conservatism/compatibility is not supervisory nonblocking under plant controllability/observability, and neither establishes inevitable global progress.
Revising the observer, policy or acceptance method must not allow the successor mechanism to authorise or certify itself circularly.
Both retain a negative inference boundary between representation-level success and delivered-system quality; neither rejects the valid lower-layer result.
Coverage of a selected set is not arbitrary behaviour correctness; oracle and unexamined interactions remain distinct limitations.
Recovered structure needs independent domain/person/history corroboration before being presented as intended design.
Stable labels or sets do not establish semantic compatibility of supported observers.
Architectural data, training/serving and hidden-consumer dependencies identify consequential maintenance artefacts beyond source code.
Static feature binding alone cannot be used as proof of environment-independent operation or safe adaptation.
Where independent product schedules require consumer action, support relationships are not operable until recipients can determine and take that action.

known_limitations: Some guarded junctions are deliberately broad; material means a stated direct conceptual relation is established, not equivalence or empirical causation.
NO_MATERIAL_RELATION is a scoped negative finding after this finite screening and may be revisited with a specific semantic counterexample.
No independent human or model assessor participated; a separate checker and a second adversarial readback pass provide procedural, not assessor, independence.
complete_original_rules.method: Analyst-authored semantic profiles/junctions followed by deterministic full-pair expansion. A rule establishes a conditional conceptual relation, not an unguarded system fact. The matched objects, criteria, mechanisms, triggers, authority and evidence are retained in every relation.

tension_rules.bounded_synthesis: Adjudicate the changed obligation, revise the correct object, and bound product exceptions without erasing ancestry.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_a: Historical conformance blocks a legitimate improvement or defect correction.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_b: Unqualified evolution excuses harmful erosion and silently withdraws product guarantees.
tension_rules.name: Architectural stability versus authorised adaptation
tension_rules.nature_of_tension: A shared architectural constraint can protect a live promise or entrench an obsolete implementation; drift alone cannot distinguish them.
tension_rules.side_a_justified_when: Supported observers and reused assurance still rely on the invariant.
tension_rules.side_b_justified_when: Current consequences or authorised intent invalidate the historic rule, and replacement evidence exists.
tension_rules.unresolved_remainder: The corpora do not supply a universal threshold between erosion and beneficial drift; the disputed consumer and effect remain contextual.

tension_rules.bounded_synthesis: Negotiate bounded shared interfaces and arbitration; allow explicit exceptions, separate baselines or exit where common authority is absent.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_a: Central authority is invented, queues grow and valid product needs are suppressed.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_b: Incompatible local optima and unsupported exceptions contaminate shared assurances.
tension_rules.name: Family consistency versus product autonomy
tension_rules.nature_of_tension: Shared asset invariants can protect products while family-wide approval can prevent legitimate local or independent-owner action.
tension_rules.side_a_justified_when: A variation changes a shared interface or relied-on guarantee.
tension_rules.side_b_justified_when: Local decisions remain within shared consequences, or an independent owner has not delegated authority.
tension_rules.unresolved_remainder: Legitimate disagreements may remain irreconcilable; technical composition cannot manufacture decision rights.

tension_rules.bounded_synthesis: Start from the actual decision, use appropriate views, and widen on consequential discrepancies or counterexamples.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_a: Every small repair waits for an unattainable complete system model.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_b: Unexamined nonlocal effects are passed off as known independence.
tension_rules.name: Broad reconstruction versus change-specific understanding
tension_rules.nature_of_tension: Broader reconstruction can expose hidden coupling but imposes cost and model-maintenance obligations.
tension_rules.side_a_justified_when: Contradictory evidence or consequential uncertainty defeats the local boundary.
tension_rules.side_b_justified_when: A defensible local question and bounded dependency envelope are sufficient.
tension_rules.unresolved_remainder: Unknown consumers and incomplete execution traces prevent a universal completeness threshold.

tension_rules.bounded_synthesis: Compare the same obligations over a declared horizon; retain selective commonality and justified exceptions without a universal product-count rule.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_a: A mandatory common platform absorbs unsupported variation and sunk cost.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_b: Untracked divergence duplicates fixes and loses support provenance.
tension_rules.name: Reuse investment versus selective reuse or cloning
tension_rules.nature_of_tension: Shared production can amortise change but may create speculative infrastructure and coordination cost.
tension_rules.side_a_justified_when: Repeated demanded variants and sustainable support make common assets worthwhile.
tension_rules.side_b_justified_when: Demand is uncertain, needs conflict or the adequate independent route costs less.
tension_rules.unresolved_remainder: No representative universal break-even point or lifetime superiority estimate is supplied.

tension_rules.bounded_synthesis: Name supported observers, communicate actionable change and preserve or explicitly revise the promise for each supported baseline.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_a: Obsolete contracts become perpetual and harmful behaviour cannot be corrected.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_b: Unilateral breakage strands consumers despite locally correct new code.
tension_rules.name: Backwards compatibility versus deliberate breaking change
tension_rules.nature_of_tension: Existing supported interactions can conflict with needed corrections, new constraints or an unsustainable support horizon.
tension_rules.side_a_justified_when: Consumers retain legitimate support promises and feasible continued service.
tension_rules.side_b_justified_when: Affected parties authorise the changed obligation and a feasible migration, parallel baseline or accepted loss exists.
tension_rules.unresolved_remainder: Unknown consumers and disputed support promises can constrain release without admitting a universal solution.

tension_rules.bounded_synthesis: Compare variant-indexed constraints; use bounded substitutions, exceptions or a split when necessary, without inventing numeric utility weights.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_a: Portfolio benefit averages away unacceptable losses for a product population.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_b: Every preference becomes a permanent fork and destroys useful commonality.
tension_rules.name: Commonality versus product-specific quality limits
tension_rules.nature_of_tension: One common architecture may violate a particular product's quality or externally supplied obligation even when portfolio averages improve.
tension_rules.side_a_justified_when: The common design satisfies every relevant non-negotiable product limit and its reuse benefit is warranted.
tension_rules.side_b_justified_when: A product has a genuine incompatible limit or cost burden that the common design cannot adequately accommodate.
tension_rules.unresolved_remainder: Which trade-offs are legitimately acceptable is not settled by economic or technical modelling alone.

tension_rules.bounded_synthesis: Retain the smallest shared conventions and correspondences that have a consumer; expressly reject mandatory complete 4+1 and feature-tree sufficiency.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_a: The full view set or plan becomes a proxy for actual knowledge and quality.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_b: Missing explanation obstructs builders, successors or cross-boundary review.
tension_rules.name: Shared documentation conventions versus concern-driven omission
tension_rules.nature_of_tension: Common views or production instructions can enable collaboration, while mandatory complete templates can create unused and stale artefacts.
tension_rules.side_a_justified_when: Real consumers need multiple distinctions or repeatable cross-team construction.
tension_rules.side_b_justified_when: A simpler checked representation answers the consequential question.
tension_rules.unresolved_remainder: The maintenance cost and adequacy of a particular documentation set require actual use evidence.

tension_rules.bounded_synthesis: Choose or combine methods by claim, model applicability and missed-effect consequence; restrict configurations when adequate evidence is infeasible.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_a: A model is expanded indefinitely while unmodelled reality and implementation mapping remain unchecked.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_b: Cheap testing is mistaken for complete correctness or critical interactions are knowingly omitted.
tension_rules.name: Formal coverage versus proportionate assurance
tension_rules.nature_of_tension: Stronger modelled coverage can justify important claims but modelling cost, semantic omissions and state growth can dominate.
tension_rules.side_a_justified_when: A tractable consequential formal property and demonstrable model-to-implementation mapping exist.
tension_rules.side_b_justified_when: A scoped risk-informed sample, direct check or constrained state space answers the actual decision more economically.
tension_rules.unresolved_remainder: The corpora do not provide a universal acceptable risk budget or economically complete abstraction.

tension_rules.bounded_synthesis: Separate intended differences from retained promises and source the oracle independently of the candidate's own output.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_a: Every golden output becomes an immutable specification.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_b: Tests are rewritten merely to make the candidate pass, hiding regressions.
tension_rules.name: Characterised behaviour versus intended change
tension_rules.nature_of_tension: Observed behaviour is useful regression evidence but can encode defects or outdated intent.
tension_rules.side_a_justified_when: The observer corresponds to a legitimately retained commitment.
tension_rules.side_b_justified_when: An authorised change explicitly revises the relevant outcome while retaining independent obligations.
tension_rules.unresolved_remainder: Disputed historical intent cannot be recovered from observation alone.

tension_rules.bounded_synthesis: Permit only justified transitions with observed realisation and state/effect-aware recovery; use safe reconfiguration phases or earlier binding where appropriate.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_a: Valid endpoint selection is used to justify unsafe or irreversible transitions.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_b: All useful runtime adaptation is prohibited even where a bounded safe protocol exists.
tension_rules.name: Runtime flexibility versus transition and recovery assurance
tension_rules.nature_of_tension: Late-bound choices respond to context but introduce intermediate states and can remove repair options.
tension_rules.side_a_justified_when: A real operational need cannot be met adequately by earlier binding and the action envelope is established.
tension_rules.side_b_justified_when: Live transfer or recovery cannot be adequately assured, or static/restart operation is cheaper and adequate.
tension_rules.unresolved_remainder: Adequate plant/observer models and open-world effects remain context-specific.

tension_rules.bounded_synthesis: Compare complete bounded workflows and delegate only the supported object/action envelope; retain unresolved long-horizon and replacement claims.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_a: Fluent output and benchmark passage are promoted into autonomous lifecycle stewardship.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_b: An adverse result from one task becomes a universal prohibition of useful assistance.
tension_rules.name: Automation speed versus acceptance and total cost
tension_rules.nature_of_tension: Faster suggestions can increase validation, comprehension or later support costs and cannot authorise their own application.
tension_rules.side_a_justified_when: Bounded assistance reduces full task burden with adequate output evidence.
tension_rules.side_b_justified_when: Verification, uncertainty or external-action risk exceeds the apparent generation benefit.
tension_rules.unresolved_remainder: No general unattended capability or superior lifecycle regeneration result is established by these inputs.

tension_rules.bounded_synthesis: Assess the combined arrangement, preserve the protected outcome, and consolidate, substitute or retire only with a residual-obligation account.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_a: Assurance accumulates without consumers, suppressing useful work and hiding conflicting rules.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_b: Cost cutting removes rare but necessary protection and calls that proportionality.
tension_rules.name: Individually justified controls versus combined burden
tension_rules.nature_of_tension: Several local controls can duplicate evidence, conflict or consume the capacity needed to protect the system.
tension_rules.side_a_justified_when: Each control protects a live consequential obligation not adequately discharged elsewhere.
tension_rules.side_b_justified_when: A combined arrangement is redundant, dominated, obsolete or unsustainably costly.
tension_rules.unresolved_remainder: No empirical optimum for the complete SSS control arrangement is available.

tension_rules.bounded_synthesis: Bind each propagation decision to actual product/baseline evidence and communicate the compatible independent or coordinated path.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_a: One slow or exceptional product blocks urgent justified repairs everywhere.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_b: Untracked skew leaves products without an applicable fix or valid support path.
tension_rules.name: Synchronous shared propagation versus independent releases
tension_rules.nature_of_tension: A shared fix can benefit all products but simultaneous rollout may be infeasible or amplify a common fault.
tension_rules.side_a_justified_when: A tightly coupled supported obligation requires coordinated activation.
tension_rules.side_b_justified_when: Products have independent acceptable schedules and compatible older baselines remain supportable.
tension_rules.unresolved_remainder: Actual support horizon, release capacity and consumer reach are not determined by this synthesis.

tension_rules.bounded_synthesis: Keep local results with their assumptions; separately model or constrain relevant coupled states and the actual progress obligation.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_a: Local theorems are conjoined into an unsupported global liveness guarantee.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_b: Useful bounded formal results are discarded merely because they do not prove the whole system.
tension_rules.name: Local formal guarantees versus global progress
tension_rules.nature_of_tension: Wright deadlock freedom and supervisory nonblocking have different semantics; neither automatically establishes progress of their coupled execution.
tension_rules.side_a_justified_when: The local theorem's formal conditions and implementation correspondence are actually met.
tension_rules.side_b_justified_when: A composite progress or safety obligation concerns interactions outside either local model.
tension_rules.unresolved_remainder: No frozen common plant, scheduler/fairness assumption or refinement proof decides the general theorem-composition question.

tension_rules.bounded_synthesis: Distinguish new-product admission, support, running operation and historical retrieval; retire each on its own observed witness.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_a: Deletion strands historical or supported consumers and falsely declares completion.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_b: Everything is preserved as a live service indefinitely with no continuing purpose.
tension_rules.name: Termination versus enduring support and preservation
tension_rules.nature_of_tension: Removing a route or feature can reduce cost while older products, records or recovery procedures still depend on it.
tension_rules.side_a_justified_when: Its live obligations have ended or are explicitly transferred.
tension_rules.side_b_justified_when: An actual supported product or declared preservation purpose still requires the object.
tension_rules.unresolved_remainder: Hidden consumers and the horizon of a legitimate retention obligation may remain uncertain.

tension_rules.bounded_synthesis: State the finite examined envelope, unresolved remainder and action restriction; choose a cheaper or no-change branch where assurance is inadequate.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_a: The system cannot take any bounded action because unknown unknowns are treated as an obligation to enumerate everything.
tension_rules.failure_universalising_b: A budget cutoff is misrepresented as proof that no consequential omissions exist.
tension_rules.name: Counterexample challenge versus finite inquiry capacity
tension_rules.nature_of_tension: Searching for consequential omissions improves scope but can expand without bound in an open environment.
tension_rules.side_a_justified_when: A plausible missed effect could change the decision or violate a supported obligation.
tension_rules.side_b_justified_when: Further inquiry is dominated or unsupported, and the remaining claim can be safely narrowed or the action constrained.
tension_rules.unresolved_remainder: No universal stopping rule eliminates open-world uncertainty.

unresolved_pair_questions.question: Does reliable autonomous architecture yield durable net maintainability through repeated evolution? Neither a general capability nor a longitudinal causal comparison is established.
Can these two general unattended capabilities be composed into reliable authorised lifecycle stewardship? The frozen corpora lack a demonstrated common operating envelope.
Does autonomous architecting make regeneration a superior replacement for maintained variability? No such replacement comparison is established.
Would regeneration reduce multi-release comprehension, regression and support burden against a competent maintained-family baseline? Short-run evidence does not determine that relation.
Could regeneration discharge general unattended product-family maintenance obligations? An end-to-end capability and authority argument is missing.
Can general autonomous reconstruction reverse the practical loss of evolution capacity in servicing systems? Servicing irreversibility is contested and general autonomy unresolved.
Can regeneration economically restore genuine evolution capacity for a servicing-only family? Neither disputed lifecycle diagnosis nor exploratory regeneration settles this.

relation_types.CONSTRAINS_UNSUPPORTED_INFERENCE: A retained native critical restriction blocks a named overbroad receiving inference at the stated misuse. It does not rehabilitate the rejected universal.
relation_types.SUPPLIES_BOUNDED_CRITICAL_WITNESS: An actual source task under stated guards can provide a concrete contrary case to the receiving rejected universal inference, without proving a general empirical alternative.
relation_types.SUPPLIES_GUARDED_INPUT_OR_CONSTRAINT: A native producer output or retained constraint changes a named receiver input, premise or scope under explicit object/version/purpose guards; it does not need to prove the entire receiver postcondition.

body.reverse_rule: Every new direction has its own actual contribution, consumed field, guard, consequence, counter-control and remaining premises. Neither converse nor symmetry is inferred automatically. Native individual refinements and unresolved one-direction records remain intact.
body.scoped_reentry: A specific shared object, consumed criterion or disputed warrant that changes the receiving decision reopens the affected negative and all siblings authored by the same faulty premise. Reopen dependent clusters, configurations, novelty and report claims too; a title match or uncovered software technology alone is not a scientific counterexample.
